Welcome to the Peggy Adams Animal Rescue League's YouTube page! We are also known as the Humane Society of the Palm Beaches.

On this channel you will see videos of facility, staff, volunteers and special events. We will also share videos of loving dogs and cats that are in search of finding their forever homes. Please share these videos!.

About us: Peggy Adams Animal Rescue League's mission is to provide shelter to lost, homeless, and unwanted dogs and cats; to furnish medical and other services for the care of companion animals; to care for, protect, and find quality homes for homeless and neglected animals; to advocate animal welfare; and community involvement and education to further the bond between people and animals, for the mutual benefit of both. The vision of the League is to create a community where 100% of all adoptable animals find loving homes and no animals will be euthanized because of pet overpopulation.
